title: Palantir's 'Otherworldly' Commercial Sales Boost Outlook
description: Shares of Palantir Technologies Inc. surge as the company reports 'otherworldly' commercial sales and lifts its revenue outlook, driven by demand for its AI software.

sections.heading: Financial Performance
paragraphs: According to The Japan Times, Palantir Technologies Inc. has reported 'otherworldly' commercial sales, which has led to the company lifting its revenue outlook.

sections.heading: Market Reaction
paragraphs: CNBC reports that Palantir's shares jumped 30% following the announcement of 'otherworldly' commercial revenue.
